title: Robbie Williams' surprise singalong after Peru gig cancelled
summary: Robbie Williams gave an impromptu performance outside a hotel in Lima after his stadium concert was cancelled.

blocks.text: Robbie Williams gave an impromptu performance outside a hotel in Peru's capital Lima, after his concert at stadium in the city was cancelled.
Authorities announced that the Arena 1 Park gig could not go ahead, citing failures by the venue to comply with safety regulations.
Robbie told fans outside his hotel he was "broken-hearted" and held a brief singalong with the cheering crowds.
